name: B67 - Sending and receiving GIFs and gif picker tests

steps.name: locator.getByText('Your request is making it\'s way!').waitFor
Open gif picker and validate user can change gif size view
Send a Gif to the other user
Validate GIF sent is displayed on local and remote sides
Validate GIF sent is displayed in chat preview from sidebar as last message sent
Validate user can navigate through all categories of gifs
